description: MAG-1 Z=126 verification: count self-conjugate partitions of 3Z=378 via generating function (OEIS A000700) + sample 100 random SC partitions and verify κ_λ=0 on each. (Full enumeration of SC partitions of 378 is hours-scale; this script uses the exact-count + random-sample approach to demonstrate the framework on the seventh magic number.)
note: Full enumeration would visit all 174,972,341 self-conjugate partitions; sampling 100 + verifying κ=0 on each is the practical numerical demonstration. The mathematical proof (κ(λ')=-κ(λ) ⇒ self-conj ⇒ κ=0) holds for all n; this witness verifies the framework code path on a representative sample of Z=126.
